value.description: Value of the entitlement right after the reset.

description:
Payload of `v1.entitlement.usage.reset`.

The entitlement, feature, customer and value have the shapes the v3 API
returns. A change to those models changes this contract, so definitions.sum
fails until the change is either accepted as a new Event type version or
this payload is frozen into dedicated models.

feature.description: The feature the customer is entitled to use.
feature.title: Feature

customer.description: The customer the entitlement belongs to.
customer.title: Customer

active_from.description: The time from which the entitlement is active.
active_from.title: Active from

active_to.description:
The time until which the entitlement is active. If not set, the entitlement is
active until deleted.
active_to.title: Active to

created_at.description: The time the entitlement was created.

updated_at.description: The time the entitlement was last updated.

deleted_at.description: The time the entitlement was deleted.

usage_period.description:
The usage period of the entitlement. The balance resets at the start of every
period.
usage_period.title: Usage period

current_usage_period.description: The current usage period of the entitlement.
current_usage_period.title: Current usage period

is_soft_limit.description:
If true, the customer keeps access to the feature after the balance is
exhausted.
is_soft_limit.title: Soft limit

issue.description: Usage granted automatically after each reset. Cannot be combined with `grants`.
issue.title: Issue after reset

issue_after_reset.description: The amount granted automatically after each reset.
issue_after_reset.title: Initial grant amount

issue_after_reset_priority.description: The priority of the grant created after each reset.
issue_after_reset_priority.title: Issue grant after reset priority

preserve_overage_at_reset.description: If true, the overage is preserved at reset. If false, the usage is reset to 0.
preserve_overage_at_reset.title: Preserve overage at reset

measure_usage_from.description: The time from which usage is measured.
measure_usage_from.title: Measure usage from

last_reset.description: The time of the last reset.
last_reset.title: Last reset

EntitlementMetered.description:
A metered entitlement grants a usage allowance for a feature. Access is
determined by the balance: the allowance provided by grants is burnt down by
usage.

name.description:
Display name of the resource.

Between 1 and 256 characters.

description.description:
Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.

created_at.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.

updated_at.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity last update date.

deleted_at.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity deletion date.

meter.description:
The meter that the feature is associated with and based on which usage is
calculated. If not specified, the feature is static.
meter.title: Meter reference

unit_cost.description:
Optional per-unit cost configuration. Use "manual" for a fixed per-unit cost, or
"llm" to look up cost from the LLM cost database based on meter group-by
properties.
unit_cost.title: Unit cost

Feature.description: A capability or billable dimension offered by a provider.

name.description:
Display name of the resource.

Between 1 and 256 characters.

description.description:
Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.

created_at.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.

updated_at.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity last update date.

deleted_at.description: An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity deletion date.

usage_attribution.description: Mapping to attribute metered usage to the customer by the event subject.
usage_attribution.title: Usage Attribution

primary_email.description: The primary email address of the customer.
primary_email.title: Primary Email

currency.description: Currency of the customer. Used for billing, tax and invoicing.
currency.title: Currency

billing_address.description: The billing address of the customer. Used for tax and invoicing.
billing_address.title: Billing Address

Customer.description:
Customers can be individuals or organizations that can subscribe to plans and
have access to features.

has_access.description:
Whether the customer has access to the feature. Always true for `boolean` and
`static` entitlements. Depends on balance for `metered` entitlements.

config.description:
Only available for static entitlements. Config is the JSON parsable
configuration of the entitlement. Useful to describe per customer configuration.

value.description:
Only available for metered entitlements. The balance details of the entitlement
at the evaluation time. Requires the `value` expand.

Labels.description:
Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list
or for searching across entity types.

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect",
"mesh", "kic", or "\_".

anchor.description: A date-time anchor to base the recurring period on.
anchor.title: Anchor time

interval.description: The interval duration in ISO 8601 format.
interval.title: Interval in ISO 8601 duration format

RecurringPeriod.description: Recurring period with an anchor and an interval.

from.description:
The start of the period.

The period is inclusive at the start.
from.title: Start

to.description:
The end of the period.

The period is exclusive at the end.
to.title: End

ClosedPeriod.description:
A period with defined start and end dates.

The period is always inclusive at the start and exclusive at the end.

amount.description: The amount granted after each reset, in the feature's unit.
amount.title: Initial grant amount

priority.description:
The priority of the grant created after each reset. Lower values have higher
priority.
priority.title: Issue grant after reset priority

EntitlementIssueAfterReset.description:
Usage granted automatically after each reset of a metered entitlement. The
balance returns to `amount` after every reset.

Numeric.description: Numeric represents an arbitrary precision number.

ResourceKey.description: A key is a unique string that is used to identify a resource.
ResourceKey.title: Resource Key

id.description: The ID of the meter to associate with this feature.
id.title: Meter ID

filters.description: Filters to apply to the dimensions of the meter.
filters.title: Meter dimensions filters

FeatureMeterReference.description: Reference to a meter associated with a feature.

FeatureUnitCost.description:
Per-unit cost configuration for a feature. Either a fixed manual amount or a
dynamic LLM cost lookup.

ExternalResourceKey.description:
ExternalResourceKey is a unique string that is used to identify a resource in an
external system.
ExternalResourceKey.title: External Resource Key

subject_keys.description:
The subjects that are attributed to the customer. Can be empty when no usage
event subjects are associated with the customer.
subject_keys.title: Subject Keys

CustomerUsageAttribution.description:
Mapping to attribute metered usage to the customer. One customer can have zero
or more subjects, but one subject can only belong to one customer.

CurrencyCode.description:
Three-letter [ISO4217](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html)
currency code. Custom three-letter currency codes are also supported for
convenience.

balance.description:
The remaining balance of the entitlement in the usage period at the evaluation
time.

usage.description: The usage recorded in the usage period at the evaluation time.

overage.description:
The usage exceeding the available balance in the usage period at the evaluation
time.

total_available_grant_amount.description:
The total amount granted and available to the entitlement at the evaluation
time.

grant_balances.description: The remaining balance of each grant, keyed by grant ID.

EntitlementAccessValue.description:
Balance details of a metered entitlement at the evaluation time, which is the
`at` query parameter when given and the current time otherwise.

type.description: The type discriminator for manual unit cost.

amount.description: Fixed per-unit cost amount in USD.

type.description: The type discriminator for LLM unit cost.

provider_property.description:
Meter group-by property that holds the LLM provider. Use this when the meter has
a group-by dimension for provider. Mutually exclusive with `provider`.
provider_property.title: Provider property

provider.description:
Static LLM provider value (e.g., "openai", "anthropic"). Use this when the
feature tracks a single provider. Mutually exclusive with `provider_property`.
provider.title: Provider

model_property.description:
Meter group-by property that holds the model ID. Use this when the meter has a
group-by dimension for model. Mutually exclusive with `model`.
model_property.title: Model property

model.description:
Static model ID value (e.g., "gpt-4", "claude-3-5-sonnet"). Use this when the
feature tracks a single model. Mutually exclusive with `model_property`.
model.title: Model

token_type_property.description:
Meter group-by property that holds the token type. Use this when the meter has a
group-by dimension for token type. Mutually exclusive with `token_type`.
token_type_property.title: Token type property

token_type.description:
Static token type value. Use this when the feature tracks a single token type
(e.g., only input tokens). `request` is an alias for `input`, `response` is an
alias for `output`. Mutually exclusive with `token_type_property`.
token_type.title: Token type

pricing.description:
Resolved per-token pricing from the LLM cost database. Populated in responses
when the provider and model can be determined, either from static values or from
meter group-by filters with exact matches.
pricing.title: Resolved pricing

FeatureLlmUnitCost.description:
LLM cost lookup configuration. Each dimension (provider, model, token type) can
be specified as either a static value or a meter group-by property name
(mutually exclusive).

CountryCode.description:
[ISO 3166-1](https://www.iso.org/iso-3166-country-codes.html) alpha-2 country
code. Custom two-letter country codes are also supported for convenience.
